description: Implementation of the gl::Shader class and its derived classes VertexShader and FragmentShader, handling shader compilation, source management, and shader state within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: gl::Shader
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL shader object, managing its source, compilation, and state.

classes.name: gl::ShaderState
classes.description: Holds the current state of a shader, including type, version, varyings, and compilation status.

classes.name: gl::Shader::CompilingState
classes.description: Tracks the compilation event and compiler instance during shader compilation.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the shader source code from multiple strings.

methods.name: getInfoLogLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the shader's info log.

methods.name: getInfoLog
methods.description: Retrieves the shader's info log.

methods.name: getSourceLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the shader source code.

methods.name: getTranslatedSourceLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the translated shader source.

methods.name: getTranslatedSourceWithDebugInfoLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the debug info for the translated shader.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the shader source code.

methods.name: resolveCompile
methods.description: Waits for and finalizes the shader compilation process.

methods.name: addRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the shader.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the shader if no longer used.

methods.name: isFlaggedForDeletion
methods.description: Checks if the shader is flagged for deletion.

methods.name: flagForDeletion
methods.description: Flags the shader for deletion.

methods.name: isCompiled
methods.description: Checks if the shader has been successfully compiled.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the shader compilation is complete.

methods.name: getShaderVersion
methods.description: Returns the shader's version.

methods.name: getInputVaryings
methods.description: Returns the input varyings of the shader.

methods.name: getOutputVaryings
methods.description: Returns the output varyings of the shader.

methods.name: getUniforms
methods.description: Returns the uniforms used in the shader.

methods.name: getUniformBlocks
methods.description: Returns the uniform blocks used in the shader.

methods.name: getShaderStorageBlocks
methods.description: Returns the shader storage blocks.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns the active attributes.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attributes.

methods.name: getActiveOutputVariables
methods.description: Returns active output variables.

methods.name: getTransformFeedbackVaryingMappedName
methods.description: Returns the mapped name for transform feedback varyings.

methods.name: getWorkGroupSize
methods.description: Returns the work group size for compute shaders.

methods.name: getNumViews
methods.description: Returns the number of views for vertex shaders.

methods.name: getGeometryShaderInputPrimitiveType
methods.description: Returns the input primitive type for geometry shaders.

methods.name: getGeometryShaderOutputPrimitiveType
methods.description: Returns the output primitive type for geometry shaders.

methods.name: getGeometryShaderInvocations
methods.description: Returns the number of invocations for geometry shaders.

methods.name: getGeometryShaderMaxVertices
methods.description: Returns the maximum vertices for geometry shaders.

methods.name: getCompilerResourcesString
methods.description: Returns the string describing compiler resources.
